the UML 2.x semantics is clear enough to be translated into a performance model, and that this translation can be automated.
it is possible to use UML models for performance analysis, and that this approach is more efficient than the use of SDL or Petri net models.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a methodology and a tool for the performance analysis and optimization of network systems.
the proSPEX tool allows one to automatically generate a performance model from UML diagrams, perform performance analysis and then to generate a performance model in SDL.
the proSPEX tool allows one to translate UML models to performance models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance analysis of a UML model can be done without any loss of precision, and without the need for a manual transformation.
